intent: One sentence describing what the audience must see and understand.

props.initial_state: Held securely in the right hand.
props.final_state: Still held securely in the same right hand.

timeline.state_change: Prove subject, hand, prop, and starting composition.
timeline.motion_continuity: Accelerate gradually from rest; no still-to-motion pop.
Continue the same position, direction, and cadence across both boundaries.
Decelerate smoothly into the hold; no catch-up jump.

motion.allowed_body_motion: Name the joints and torso axes that move together.
motion.locked_contacts: Name ownership and contacts that remain invariant.

locks: Exactly one physical heroine remains present.
The prop stays in the heroine's right hand.
avoid: No detached, duplicated, or ownerless hand.
No new person or prop instance appears.
acceptance: All delivery frames show exactly one physical heroine.
The visible right hand has an unbroken arm path and owns the prop.
The final half-second holds the required end state.
